# Mapping skills

<div class="note"><p>The skills are <b>non-deterministic</b>: running one twice can produce different verdicts. That is why <code>verify-analysis</code> exists, and why every mapping in the evaluation is published in both its automated and its reviewed form.</p></div>


## The pipeline

<figure class="fm-plain"><img src="{{ '/assets/images/evaluation_pipeline.png' | relative_url }}" width="314" height="271" alt="The five mapping skills and the order they run in"><figcaption>The mapping pipeline. A paper yields tools and codebases; each tool is mapped from its source or its documentation; the mappings are reconciled, then merged into a union profile.</figcaption></figure>

<p><code>refresh-feature-model-infos</code> is absent from the diagram because it sits outside the chain: it runs whenever the feature model changes, to keep the files that describe it in step.</p>


## Expected repository layout

The skills read and write fixed paths, so they expect the tree below. It is <b>not</b> this repository's layout — the skills are archived as they were run, against an earlier working tree — so reproducing a run means rebuilding this structure around them.

<pre class="pipeline">.
├── feature_model/
│   └── representation/
│       ├── feature_model.xml        the canonical model the skills read
│       └── .profiles/
│           └── &lt;tool&gt;.profile       one colour profile per tool
├── evaluation/
│   ├── analyses/
│   │   └── &lt;tool&gt;/
│   │       ├── analysis.md          the mapping, every finding citing evidence
│   │       └── README.md            how the tool was obtained and run
│   └── papers/
│       └── &lt;PaperKey&gt;.md            the tool inventory for one paper
├── papers/
│   ├── surveys/&lt;PaperKey&gt;.pdf       the source papers
│   └── tools/&lt;Tool&gt;.pdf             the per-tool papers
└── ../extracted-codebases/
    └── &lt;tool&gt;/                      cloned repositories, OUTSIDE the repo</pre>
